name: persona-intermediate-landscape-rail-nav
note: Landscape audit (2026-10-05) Direction A, navigation. Sideways on a phone the header (69px) and bottom tab bar (67px) took 40% of a 340px screen while ~190px of each side was empty gutter. The rail moves navigation to the axis landscape has spare: the SAME .tabbar element becomes a 76px left rail (Songs / Compose / Tune, same order and labels, >=56px tall buttons), the Settings gear sits at the rail top, the brand + purpose line are gone, and the content column fills the screen from the rail to the right edge and top to bottom. Asserts at 915x340 and 740x320: rail geometry, order, hit-tests and tap floors; the view starts at the top with no bottom chrome; each rail tap switches screens without moving the rail; keyboard focus order is gear -> Songs -> Compose -> Tune (DOM order unchanged); Enter on the gear opens Settings and Escape closes it. Then 412x800 and 1280x800 keep the bottom tab bar, the header and the 540px column.
